claims.claim: TF electrons are spatially variable; equilibrium EFe(r)-V(r)=constant; uniform electrons are not the same approximation.
g couplings depend on local baryon density; common SigmaR=gomega_prime*omega*n+grho_prime*rho*n3/2-gsigma_prime*phi*ns.
Off-shell scalar gradient positive, time-like vector/Coulomb gradients negative; Coulomb energy positive after Poisson elimination.
Regular centre and zero boundary field gradients; global neutrality supplies Neumann Poisson solvability; meanV=0 fixes gauge.
At fixed scaled profiles d epsilon/d logR=-2Gsigma+2Gomega+2Grho+2EC; finite differences checked for8models×3dimensions.
P=nB*muB-epsilon valid for fully optimized neutral beta-equilibrium branch; independent density finite differences and branch handling still required.
Mean species fractions are unambiguous; spherical cell counts include dripped neutrons; finite A/Z for rods/slabs requires an additional longitudinal convention.
FSU2H crust nucleonic; source crust npe approximation must monitor muon onset; no outer crust nuclear mass fidelity claim.
